title: Solve it blind and with the text
statement: Keep a question only when solvers outside the generator's model family all fail it blind and answer it with the text, failure there often meaning ambiguity or a broad key.
example: In one unit's gate, 4 items failed the with-text control, one of them genuinely ambiguous with the text.
detail: One unit's gate paired a plain blind solve, with the passage withheld, with a with-passage answerability control, and 4 items failed the control (`grade3-reading/artifacts/demo-unit-2026-07-10/items/02-gate-summary.md`, lines 8-14 and 35-36). A 480-item probe named its missing passage-present control as a gap in its own verdict (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/generator/g5/GATE1_BLIND_SOLVE_REPORT.md`, lines 50-55). A course gate used two solver families, both disjoint from the generator, and called an item clean only if every family failed to recover it and leaky if any did (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/v2_final_package/docs/COURSE_QUALITY_GATE_REPORT.md`, lines 14-19).
against: The generator itself stayed a single family (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/v2_final_package/docs/COURSE_QUALITY_GATE_REPORT.md`, line 124), and separate agents with shared write access are not enforced independence (`grade3-reading/artifacts/codex-qa/tool-reuse-assessment-2026-09-14.md`, line 47). How strict the bar without the text should be is a choice: both bars in the generation run were designed to avoid frontier-model-proofing a Grade 5 assessment (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-expansion-session-2026-07-08-codex/QUESTION_GENERATION_RETROSPECTIVE_2026-07-08.md`), and a course verdict template accepts a single non-writer family as a named gap rather than a failure (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-merged-course/VERDICT_TEMPLATE.md`). A pass holds only for the solver that gave it: after a with-passage calibration, a newer model answered an item 3/3 without its text where an older one had gone 0/3 (`ti-courseplans-audit/docs/handoffs-2026-07-13/course-eval-layer/README.md`, lines 85-92).

No item ships before the **empirical cross-family blind-solve run** (passage-withheld). LLM-judge passage-dependency is not a substitute.

The 417 source-attribution candidates that failed with-passage control were not mostly "leaky." They were often ambiguous or overbroad around `Both`, frequently missing one statement in an otherwise near-correct match. This is why with-passage control is a quality gate, not just an answerability formality.

36 hot-text items that were "blind-clean" but UNanswerable even with the passage were dropped as ambiguous; 18 of those were recovered after a second family (haiku) answered them correctly with the passage.
An empirical cross-family blind-solve run must clear before any build claim.
